//: Shared by every browser. tools/build_extension.py merges one of chrome.json / edge.json / firefox.json on top and fills content_scripts[0].matches from the public sample registry. Keys starting with // are comments and are dropped.
name: __MSG_extName__

content_scripts.//: matches is generated at build time: one https pattern per known people-search host. Never add a wildcard host here.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
